title: 序 最后的晚餐
content_zh:
公元2020年
珠穆朗玛
远方传来了撕裂的轰鸣。
巨大的冰层自漆黑的山峰上滑落，坠入澎湃的海中。
暴虐的冰海涌动着，澎湃万丈，好像一直延续到世界的尽头那样。然后，世界的尽头便有风吹来，夹杂着灰烬和尘埃的味道。
世界忽然间变得如此狭小。
高耸的天穹好像压下来了，变成了纯白色的铁，透过上面庞大的裂隙，能够窥见宇宙之中那些渐渐暗淡熄灭的星辰。
就好像失去电力之后一盏盏消融在黑暗中的灯。
茫茫天地之间好像已经一无所有，最后剩下的只有这一块世界上最高的狭窄平台，还有那一座临时搭建起来的工作舱。
一根钓竿从平台的边缘架起，将鱼线抛入了海中，浮标在浑浊的海水之中起伏着。
百无聊赖的垂钓者带着毡帽，躺在自己的折叠椅。
好像打发时间一样，他甚至还带着一张有些年头的棋盘，罔顾远处不断崩裂的巨响，随意地摆弄着上面的棋子。
仿佛经历了漫长的岁月，黑白双方的棋子都已经难以凑齐，‘人丁凋零’，硕果仅存的‘国王’和‘主教’也已经残缺不全，在岁月风化之下遍布裂隙。
连棋盘都缺了一大块边角，黑和白的格子扭曲混杂在了一处，形成了大片混沌的灰。
可令人惊讶的是，不论如何地动山摇，那些棋子始终稳稳地屹立在自己的领土之上，不曾有丝毫的动摇。
“会长，NASA发消息过来了——”
带着厚重眼镜的助手从舱里走出来，提着最后的行李：“——第四次结算完毕，纽约证券所已经上传完成，他们要撤离了，说祝我们工作顺利。”
“早该滚蛋了。”
会长不快地摇头：“统辖局那群家伙真麻烦，总是磨磨蹭蹭，搬家都不利索。”
“要保存备份嘛。‘天堂’陨落之后，数据转移起来就只能靠硬盘了。”

“别傻了，孩子。”会长嗤之以鼻：“那群家伙只是单纯喜欢享受踩铃的感觉而已，好像自己有多专业守时一样，啧，早十分钟又不会死人。”
“啊哈哈。”
助手尴尬地笑了笑，没有再说什么，凑过去之后，就看到棋盘旁边丢着的电脑。除了两个刚刚搜索‘如何在喜马拉雅钓鱼’的页面之外，屏幕上只剩下了一副实时的卫星云图。
来自旧NASA的卫星，事到如今，依旧顽强地维持着自己的使命，将自太空之中俯瞰的画面一丝不苟地传输了回来。
只可惜，在屏幕上的已经不再是往日的美丽星辰，而是，千疮百孔。
无数乱七八糟的气旋将整个苍蓝都覆盖了，而就在那一片或者浓厚或者稀薄的台风云层之下，所显露出的却是一片又一片触目惊心的灼伤。
而就在同一时间，有一道庞大的裂口自卫星图上缓缓浮现，一线赤红自数千公里的庞大尺度上蔓延，迅速地延伸拓展，拉扯着周围枯黄的大陆和黑灰色的海洋，最后掀动了飓风，将大气层撕开了又一道口子。
“那是地震吧？”
助手愕然地感叹，凑了过去，“真厉害啊，没想到会这么壮观。”
会长抬头看了一眼，旋即了然：“是地热爆发了。地核开始冷却之后，第三波震荡正从北美和南美的大陆板块释放出来，放着不管的话，大概六十年之后就会结束吧……看，纽约，陷到海里了。”
“真可惜啊，我还没看过自由女神呢。”
“我去过。”
会长收回视线，“其实没什么意思……”
远方骤然有轰鸣声传来，海洋的深处好像有什么光亮起了，赤红色在漆黑中翻滚着，映照出来自地壳之下的痛苦灼光。
焚风从海的尽头吹来，裹挟着灰色的尘埃和白色的雾气，就好像将整个世界都覆盖了一样。
如同全世界都被海水煮沸了一样。
“和铁板烧真像啊。”会长忽然说。
“嗯？”
“铁板烧，上次不是带你吃过的吗？味道很不错哦。”
会长像是困了，躺在椅子上，用帽子盖住脸，好像准备睡上一觉，说话的声音也轻柔地像是梦呓：“以前的时候，有个瀛洲的朋友告诉我，铁板烧其实分作关东和关西两种，大家一般吃到的都是关东的那种，省事儿又简单，可真正美妙的是关西的风味。

因为它只会在一开始的时候在铁板上涂一层很薄的油，只要温度足够，食材本身的油脂就能将自己烧熟，据说这样才能吃到食材天然的鲜美和本味……”
助手沉默了片刻，“听起来真残忍啊。”
“是啊，可人类本身不就是这么残忍的生物么？”会长反问：“倘若吃才能活下去的话，那就会吃，这才是最简单的道理，扎根在人性上的恶。
一开始吞吃雷和火，焚烧旷野，挖掘煤矿，然后抽取石油，石油不足，便觊觎裂变……紧接着到如今，就算是这个世界要死去了，也不会松口。
早在我们的祖先把尼安德特人放进食谱开始，就一发不可收拾了。”
助手回过头，看着躺椅上那个男人，可是隔着帽子却看不清他的脸，分不清那个人的眼神究竟是悲悯，是往日自己所熟悉的讥诮和嘲弄。
在漫长的沉默之中，天色也越来越暗了，原本纯白的天空渐渐阴晦，直到最后，云层之后的那一轮幻光渐渐收缩，消散……
“太阳也快熄灭了吗？”
“是啊，源质之柱的力量开始收束了。”
“风暴又刮起来了啊。”
“恩。”
“这一次会停下吗？”
“谁知道呢？”会长缓缓的起身，将帽子重新戴在头上，“不管如何改变，这里都不是人类能生存的土地了……你不是已经看到了吗？除了这一身的伤痛，它已经一无所有。”
他停顿了一下，轻声呢喃：“这便是我们最后的晚餐。”
最后一根烟卷点燃了。
火光明灭，一线青烟袅袅升起。
就在电脑屏幕上，所有代表卫星讯号渐渐熄灭下去，取而代之的是一个又一个古怪的徽记，它们运行在漆黑的屏幕上，好像神灵运行在自己的渊面之上，带着难以言喻的冷厉和威严。
理想国，上线。
存续院，上线。
统辖局，上线。

石釜学会、青铜之手、无归者墓地……
隔着黑色的屏幕和自身的徽记，好像有无数视线投在这一片最后的土地上，迎接着最终时刻的到来。
所有的客人已经入位，等待着最后的幕布揭开。
凝视着那一张残缺的棋盘。
助手紧张地吞了口吐沫，仔细地看着手里的怀表，当时针和分针重叠的瞬间，他触电一般地抬头报告：“神髓之柱预热完毕。”
“……等等！”
会长忽然皱眉，好像侧耳倾听。
不只是助手，屏幕上的那些徽记仿佛也严肃起来，如临大敌。
紧接着，那个家伙忽然伸手一扯，钓竿被拔起来，从海中竟然真的扯上来了一只什么东西。看上去毛茸茸的，像是猫一样，可是却长着鱼一样的尾巴，说不出的奇怪。
“啊哈，等了两个小时，还是有成果的嘛。谁说千度百科不靠谱的？”会长眉开眼笑，端详着自己的‘收获’：“真有缘啊，小东西！不过怎么看都不太像是鱼啊，能吃吗？”
“……”
所有人都沉默着，没有说话。
不太想理他。
被钓竿扯上来，那个小东西不快地张嘴叫了两声，伸出两只小前爪想要挠他的脸，却被他随手塞进了鱼篓中。
重归海水之后，它便安分了下来，翻了个身，懒得动了。
“行了。”会长将钓竿和桶塞进助手怀里，扛起了自己的椅子，“准备走吧。”
他伸手，从棋盘上摘下了白色的战车。
伴随着他的动作，好像最后的灯光熄灭了。
高悬在天穹之外的太阳失去了踪迹。
世上一切陷入了黑暗之中。

看不见光之后，也再听不见任何的风声，因为除了他们之外，一切都戛然而止，仿佛时光为之冻结。
首先离开的是宇宙，因为一只纤细修长的手掌不知从何处而来，摘下了黑色的皇后——理想国抽去了星质之基——于是原暗褪去，无数星辰荡然无存，只剩毫无意义的虚空。
紧接着抽身的是残存的海洋，存续院搬走了存在之证，黑色的主教消失无踪。不论是滔天的海啸还是沸腾的赤红之海，这世上的一切活水都在迅速的下降，坍塌，到最后，只留下一片漆黑的海床。
然后，白色的主教幻象一般消融，统辖局关闭了辉煌之光，所以，万物静谧，轰鸣的地壳陷入沉寂，裂缝中喷薄而出的熔岩迅速地凝固，失去了所有热量……
如今，亚洲、欧洲、非洲、南美、北美；荒芜大地、暴虐海洋、冰冷或炽热的飓风里，再或者天空之上……一切都在有条不紊地毁灭着。
只剩下世界崩解的低沉悲鸣。
像是琴弦一根根地断裂一样，到最后，只剩下空洞的回音。
在这庞大而孤独的毁灭之中，旧盖亚·地球Ⅷ，迎来了自己的结局。
当最后一根烟抽完之后，这千疮百孔的世界只剩下了最后的轮廓，还有会长身旁最后一扇未曾关闭的门。
“第十四个被废弃的伊甸和应许之地啊……”
会长静静地凝视着面前空空荡荡的棋盘，从怀中取出了一束纯白的花束，不知来自何处的花瓣上还残留着露水。
宛如眼泪，滴落在棋盘的裂隙中。
“感谢您这三百多年以来的收留与忍耐，真是辛苦了。”
他摘下帽子，温柔地道别，向这一切：
“——终有一日，让我们在其他的地狱之中再见吧。”
最后，门关上了。
永恒的黑暗和寂静里，再无任何意义的空间向内收缩，拉扯着苟延残喘的光谱开始了徒劳的红移，伴随着四大基本力的崩溃，棋盘和花泯灭在虚无中。
八号地球湮灭完毕。
国际天文会第十四次灭世计划，就此完成。
在最后的一瞬间，一线微光自棋盘之上浮现，在花的垂泪中勾勒出皇后的纯白轮廓，宛如流星一般，飞向了远方。

旧的世界再一次地死去了，像过去无数次那样。
再然后，新的世界到来。
万物运转如常。
这便是九十年前残存的记录，辉煌时代的最后残影。
自此之后，再无这般荣华。
content_en:
AD 2020
Everest
A tearing roar came from the distance.
Huge sheets of ice slid off the dark mountain peaks and fell into the surging sea.
The violent ice sea surged and surged, as if it continued to the end of the world. Then, the wind blew from the end of the world, carrying the smell of ashes and dust.
The world suddenly became so small.
The towering sky seems to have pressed down and turned into pure white iron. Through the huge cracks above, one can glimpse the stars in the universe that are gradually dimming and extinguishing.
It's like lights disappearing into the darkness after losing power.
It seems that there is nothing left in the vast world, and the only thing left is the tallest narrow platform in the world and the temporary work cabin.
A fishing rod was set up from the edge of the platform and the fishing line was thrown into the sea. The buoy undulated in the turbid water.
The bored angler, wearing a felt hat, lay on his folding chair.
As if to pass the time, he even brought an old chessboard with him, playing with the chess pieces on it casually, ignoring the loud cracking noises in the distance.
It seems that after a long time, the chess pieces of both the black and white sides have been difficult to gather, and the "people are withering". The only remaining "king" and "bishop" are also incomplete, with cracks everywhere under the weather of time.
Even the chessboard was missing a large corner, and the black and white grids were twisted and mixed together, forming a large area of ​​chaotic gray.
But what is surprising is that no matter how the earth shakes, those chess pieces always stand firmly on their territory without wavering at all.
"President, NASA has sent a message——"
The assistant wearing thick glasses walked out of the cabin, carrying the last luggage: "——The fourth settlement is completed, the New York Stock Exchange has uploaded it, and they are leaving. They wish us good luck in our work."
"It's time to get out."
The president shook his head unhappily: "Those guys in the command bureau are really troublesome. They are always dragging their feet and it's not easy to move."
"You need to keep backups. After the fall of Paradise, the only way to transfer data is through hard drives."
"Don't be stupid, kid." The president sneered: "Those guys just like to enjoy the feeling of stepping on the bell, as if they are professional and punctual. Tsk, ten minutes early will not kill anyone."
"Ahaha."
The assistant smiled awkwardly and didn't say anything else. When he came over, he saw the computer missing next to the chessboard. Apart from the two pages that had just been searched for ‘how to fish in the Himalayas’, there was only a real-time satellite cloud image left on the screen.
The satellites from the old NASA still tenaciously maintain their mission to this day, meticulously transmitting back the pictures from space.
It's a pity that what's on the screen is no longer the beautiful stars of the past, but instead, it's riddled with holes.
Countless chaotic cyclones covered the entire blue sky, but beneath the thick or thin typhoon clouds, what was revealed were patches of shocking burns.
At the same time, a huge crack slowly emerged from the satellite image. A line of red spread from a huge scale of thousands of kilometers, rapidly extending and expanding, pulling the surrounding yellow continent and black and gray ocean, and finally set off a hurricane, tearing another hole in the atmosphere.
"That was an earthquake, right?"
The assistant sighed in astonishment and leaned over, "It's really amazing. I didn't expect it to be so spectacular."
The president looked up and understood immediately: "It was a geothermal explosion. After the earth's core began to cool, the third wave of shocks was being released from the continental plates of North and South America. If left alone, it will end in about sixty years... Look, New York has sunk into the sea."
"What a shame, I haven't seen the Statue of Liberty yet.""I've been there."
The president looked away, "It's actually not interesting..."
Suddenly there was a roar in the distance, and something seemed to light up in the depths of the ocean. The red color rolled in the darkness, reflecting the painful light from under the earth's crust.
The foehn wind blows from the end of the sea, carrying gray dust and white mist, as if covering the entire world.
It was like the whole world was boiled by sea water.
"It's so similar to Teppanyaki." The president suddenly said.
"Huh?"
"Teppanyaki, didn't I take you to eat it last time? It tastes very good."
The president seemed to be sleepy, lying on the chair, covering his face with a hat, as if he was preparing to take a nap, and his voice was soft as if he was talking in his sleep: "In the past, a friend from Yingzhou told me that Teppanyaki is actually divided into two types: Kanto and Kansai. What everyone usually eats is the Kanto one, which is trouble-free and simple, but the really wonderful flavor is the Kansai flavor.
Because it will only apply a very thin layer of oil on the iron plate at the beginning. As long as the temperature is enough, the oil of the ingredients will cook itself. It is said that only in this way can you eat the natural deliciousness and flavor of the ingredients..."
The assistant was silent for a moment, "It sounds so cruel."
"Yes, but aren't humans themselves such cruel creatures?" The president asked: "If you can survive by eating, then you will eat. This is the simplest truth, evil rooted in human nature.
At first, it devoured thunder and fire, burned the wilderness, dug coal mines, and then extracted oil. When the oil was insufficient, it coveted fission... and now, even if the world is about to die, it will not let go.
As early as our ancestors introduced Neanderthals into the diet, it got out of hand. "
The assistant turned back and looked at the man on the couch, but he couldn't see his face clearly through the hat. He couldn't tell whether the man's eyes were filled with compassion or the ridicule and ridicule he was familiar with in the past.
In the long silence, the sky became darker and darker, and the originally pure white sky gradually became gloomier, until finally, the round of phantom light behind the clouds gradually shrank and dissipated...
"Is the sun going out soon?"
"Yes, the power of the Pillar of Origin has begun to shrink."
"The storm is blowing again."
"Yeah."
"Will it stop this time?"
"Who knows?" The president slowly stood up and put his hat back on his head. "No matter how it changes, this is no longer a land where humans can survive...haven't you seen it? Apart from the pain, it has nothing left."
He paused and murmured softly: "This is our last supper."
The last cigarette was lit.
The fire went out, and a line of green smoke curled up.
On the computer screen, all representative satellite signals gradually extinguished, replaced by strange emblems one after another. They ran on the dark screen, as if gods were running on the surface of their own abyss, with indescribable coldness and majesty.
Utopia, online.
Survival Institute, online.
The governing bureau is online.
Stone Cauldron Society, Bronze Hands, Cemetery of the Unreturnable...
Across the black screen and his own emblem, there seemed to be countless eyes cast on this last piece of land, welcoming the arrival of the final moment.
All the guests have taken their seats, waiting for the final curtain to lift.
Staring at the incomplete chessboard.
The assistant swallowed nervously and looked at the pocket watch in his hand carefully. The moment the hour and minute hands overlapped, he raised his head and reported as if he was electrocuted: "The Pillar of Divine Marrow is warmed up."
"...wait!"
The president suddenly frowned, as if listening.
Not only the assistants, but also the emblems on the screen seemed to be serious, as if they were facing a formidable enemy.
Immediately afterwards, the guy suddenly stretched out his hand and pulled the fishing rod up, and actually pulled something out of the sea. fancyIt is furry and looks like a cat, but it has a tail like a fish, which is indescribably strange.
"Ah ha, after waiting for two hours, there are still results. Who said Qiandu Encyclopedia is unreliable?" The president smiled happily and looked at his 'harvest': "What a fate, little thing! But it doesn't look like fish no matter how you look at it. Can you eat it?"
"..."
Everyone was silent and didn't speak.
I don’t really want to talk to him.
After being pulled up by the fishing rod, the little thing opened his mouth and screamed twice in displeasure. He stretched out his two small front paws to scratch his face, but he stuffed it into the fish basket casually.
After returning to the sea water, it settled down, turned over, and was too lazy to move.
"Okay." The president put the fishing rod and bucket into the assistant's arms and picked up his chair. "Get ready to go."
He reached out and picked the white chariot from the chessboard.
With his movements, it seemed as if the last light went out.
The sun hanging high in the sky has lost its trace.
Everything in the world fell into darkness.
After losing sight of the light, there was no sound of wind, because except for them, everything stopped abruptly, as if time had been frozen.
The first thing to leave was the universe, because a slender and slender hand came from nowhere and picked off the black queen - the Utopia removed the foundation of ectoplasm - so the original darkness faded away, countless stars disappeared, leaving only a meaningless void.
Immediately after, the remaining ocean withdrew. The Survival Institute removed the evidence of existence, and the black bishop disappeared without a trace. Whether it is a monstrous tsunami or a boiling red sea, all the living water in the world is rapidly declining and collapsing, and in the end, only a dark seabed is left.
Then, the white bishop melted away like an illusion, and the governing authority turned off the brilliant light. Therefore, everything was quiet, the roaring crust fell into silence, and the lava spurting out of the cracks solidified rapidly, losing all heat...
Today, in Asia, Europe, Africa, South America, and North America; on the barren land, in the violent oceans, in icy or hot hurricanes, or in the sky... everything is being destroyed in an orderly manner.
Only the low scream of the world disintegrating is left.
Like the strings of a piano breaking one by one, in the end, only a hollow echo remains.
In this huge and lonely destruction, the old Gaia Earth VIII ushered in its own end.
When the last cigarette was smoked, only the final outline of this riddled world remained, as well as the last unclosed door beside the president.
"The fourteenth abandoned Eden and the Promised Land..."
The president quietly stared at the empty chessboard in front of him, and took out a bouquet of pure white flowers from his arms. There was still dew on the petals from an unknown source.
Like tears, dripping into the cracks of the chessboard.
"Thank you for your support and patience over the past three hundred years. It's been really hard work."
He took off his hat and said a gentle farewell to it all:
"——One day, let's meet again in other hells."
Finally, the door closed.
In the eternal darkness and silence, the meaningless space shrinks inward, pulling the surviving spectrum into a futile red shift. With the collapse of the four basic forces, the chessboard and flowers disappear into nothingness.
The annihilation of Earth No. 8 is complete.
The International Astronomical Society's fourteenth plan to destroy the world has been completed.
At the last moment, a glimmer of light emerged from the chessboard, outlining the pure white outline of the queen amid the flowers' tears, flying into the distance like a shooting star.
The old world dies once more, as it has done so many times before.
Then, a new world comes.
Everything works as usual.
This is the remaining record from ninety years ago, the last remnant of the glorious era.
Since then, there has been no such splendor.
